# Data policy

Consent notice version 2026-10-21 (`registry/consent.yaml`). Lodestar is for people aged 18 or over. Every change of a switch is logged as a `consent.changed` event with the notice version, and turning a switch off stops that processing at once.

## Consent switches

| Switch | Default | Required | What it allows |
|---|---|---|---|
| Core practice data (`core`) | on | yes | Your game results, your skill profile and the notes Lodestar keeps about you, stored on this server. Lodestar can't work without it. To stop it, delete your data. |
| Cloud AI (`cloud_ai`) | off | no | Lets Lodestar send short, de-identified summaries (no name, no raw answers) to the AI provider you pick, with your own key. The provider and where it processes data are shown before you turn this on. Off means Lodestar uses the local model on this server. |
| Microphone (`microphone`) | off | no | Voice commands. Your browser's speech recognition may send the audio to its maker (for Chrome, Google). Audio is not kept. |
| Camera (`camera`) | off | no | Coarse "looks strained" cues worked out on this device only. No images leave it or are stored, and they never change your profile or scores. |
| Voice tone (`voice_tone`) | off | no | Speaking speed and pauses, worked out on this device, to suggest a break. Never changes your profile or scores. |
| Games with planted mistakes (`deliberate_mistakes`) | on | no | In Spot the AI's Mistake, Lodestar's worked answers sometimes contain a mistake on purpose, so you can practise checking AI. You're always told when a game does this. |
| Research export (`research_export`) | off | no | Lets the team include your anonymised results in its evaluation of Lodestar. |

## Retention

| Data | Kept for | Enforced by |
|---|---|---|
| Camera frames | never stored; cues are worked out on the device | browser only |
| Raw audio | held in memory during transcription, never stored | `backend/api/voice.py` |
| Traces | 30 days | `make retention` |
| Chat checkpoints | 30 days | `make retention` |
| Trial events, trials, rounds, profile history | 12 months, or until deletion; a `twin.snapshot` event keeps the profile rebuildable | `make retention` |
| Memory notes (Qdrant and `core.md`) | until the user deletes them; in recall, an unused memory's weight fades over about 30 days to 25% | `backend/memory/store.py` |
| AI keys | until removed or the account is deleted; encrypted at rest, never exported, only the last 4 characters shown | `app.llm_credentials` |

The retention job runs daily and logs counts only (`backend/ethics/retention.py`).

## Your rights

- **See and edit:** the Memory & data screen shows `core.md`, life context and every memory; any line can be corrected or deleted.
- **Export:** `GET /me/export` builds a download on request from Postgres, Qdrant and the Markdown notes. Nothing is saved on the server.
- **Delete:** `DELETE /me` removes Qdrant points, notes and chat checkpoints, then every Postgres row in one cascade, and returns a receipt with counts. If Qdrant is down nothing is deleted, so a retry can finish the job.

## Face and voice

Camera and voice-tone cues never write to the skill profile, scores or plan; a test enforces this. They can only change tone and suggest a break, always together with behaviour. Text sent to a cloud AI provider is de-identified first (`backend/llm/deidentify.py`).

Legal background (Tunisian Organic Law 2004-63, the pending reform bill, EU AI Act) is in docs/plan/14.
